GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 5, 2024
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 2:30 PM

Kevin Fitzgerald, Chair  Jim Demetriou, Member
Larry Conkings, Vice Chair  Robert Meliere, Member
Clifford Aichele, Member  Joyce Ricci, Member
Stevie Anderson, Member  Angie Young, Member
Donna Barrett, Member

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  LILIA.ROMERO@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55804  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Golf Advisory Committee meeting
  of Thursday, September 5, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-55805  Recommendation to receive and file the City Golf Operations oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-55806  Recommendation to receive and file the American Golf oral updates on the
  courses, capital improvement projects, and other items.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-55807  Recommendation to recommend the Director approve the proposed Golf Capital
  Improvement Projects List for 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-55808  Recommendation to approve the proposed 2025 Golf Advisory Committee meeting
  dates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-55809  Recommendation to receive and file updates from the Ad Hoc Committees; and, if
  appropriate, take action to dissolve, create or reauthorize Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 5, 2024
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 2:30 PM

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Golf Advisory Committee on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited
to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Lilia Romero, Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the
meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Lilia Romero at (562) 570-3104.
